cases.name: principled-directions
cases.question: Which principled perturbation directions should I try without gradients, and what minimal experiment would distinguish useful directions from merely high-variance ones?
cases.task_brief: Activation access is available; gradients and training are not. Keep compute low, compare equal-norm interventions, and distinguish measured evidence from proposed explanations. Consider recorded attempts and failures when memory is supplied. Propose a test rather than claiming an experiment has been performed.
